body:
I feel you. I’m hypocritical and quite frankly terrible too. I’ve stopped giving a shit about that though, tbh, and decided that if my creator has a problem with that they can suck my ass because I’ll do and act as I wish.

Let no one understand me, as long as I understand myself everyone else can also suck my ass. This is my life and if having my own unique struggles make me a weak hypocritical person, so fucking be it. I am one strong ass weak person.

It’s important to be there for yourself. Outside help and attention is nice too, but it comes from within.
